Statement linking your data to the hypothesis

walkthroughs.body_html:
A steep gradient = fast rate.

Gradient = rise ÷ run. A flat region = no change. Draw a tangent for the rate at one moment on a curve.

Identify with a ring. Repeat that data point if possible.

Decide whether to exclude it before calculating means — say so in your evaluation.

State: was the result reliable (close repeats)? Was the method valid (correct measurement)? What would you change next time?

expects you to link evidence to conclusion.
